summary.text: Jonathan Wilk is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 20 since November 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 16, 2026, and lists his profession as firefighter.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Wilk's career experience includes roles as a firefighter, work in the oil and gas industry, ranching, law enforcement and owning a small business.
He assumed office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Sherrie Conley, and for 2025-2026 was assigned to the Commerce & Economic Development Oversight Committee.
